Hello! Thanks for stopping by my channel! My name is Tracey and I’ve been a Certified Canine Massage Therapist for 14 years. I am also Board Certified in Animal Acupressure and received my Board Certification in 2018. Each Acupressure Massage session I do is tailored specifically to the individual animal to address any issues the animal may be experiencing. It could be anxiety, arthritis, general aging, etc. I currently have an office in Sedona, Arizona and work in veterinary offices, and canine rehab clinic. I also do in-home sessions in Prescott, Arizona. 

Last year I added vibrational sound therapy using crystal singing bowls to my available services. I am amazed at how effective vibration can be with animals. Even deaf animals benefit. I spend quite a bit of time at a senior dog sanctuary in Prescott, Arizona and they have taught me so much about the benefits of sound therapy. I will be adding many videos at the sanctuary so you can see for yourself.

With Love,
Tracey
